title: SSE buffer: optimize drain and reduce copies in run_sse
description:
In run_sse (lines 179-212), the SSE event parser accumulates chunks into a String and uses drain() to remove processed events. Two inefficiencies:

1. Line 201: buf[..pos].to_string() copies the entire event block before drain() invalidates it. Use a reference or take before draining.

2. Line 202: String::drain() shifts all remaining bytes. With many small chunks or pathological patterns (1-byte chunks), this becomes O(n²). Profile under stress (100+ events/sec, small chunks) and consider BytesMut if drain shows up.

Impact: Low for typical SSE (line-oriented, reasonably-sized chunks), but preventable. Recommend profiling first to confirm drain is a bottleneck before refactoring.
